# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hi, I need to make a couple changes to my order. First, I want to modify a few items: the desk lamp to black, and the backpack to a medium polyester one—preferably grey if that color is available. Also, I accidentally sent the order to my son’s address in Washington, DC, and I need it changed to my usual address instead. My name is Ivan Khan, and my ZIP code is 28243.

To get started, I need to authenticate your account first. Could you also provide the email on the account, or if you prefer, I can proceed with your name and ZIP code only? Also, please share the order ID you want to modify.
ivan_khan_7475

Thanks, Ivan. I found your account.

Please send me the order ID you want to modify. After that, I’ll check the order status and details so I can help with:
1. changing the shipping address to your default address, and
2. updating the lamp and backpack items if the order is still eligible.
